purpose: Comparator records for NYSC COURSE-006 National Diploma In Information & Communication Technology. Records describe documented curriculum only and do not establish equivalence, quality or labour demand.
status_note: No record has been human-verified yet. Every record must be checked against its official source by a researcher before publication.

country_group_gaps.developing_emerging: No developing/emerging-economy diploma-level ICT curriculum was verified on 2026-10-18: DGT and TESDA publish no comparable diploma; NIELIT's 'A' Level syllabus could not be retrieved (the NIELIT site served only an application shell) and the NQR copy is an outdated approval sheet.
country_group_gaps.developed: The existing Singapore ITE Higher Nitec in IT Applications Development delivered programme (web dataset) is linked as the developed-economy comparator. Australia's ICT50220 Diploma of Information Technology was inspected but not used: its core units are generic and its technical content depends on a single chosen specialisation.

records.institution: Tertiary and Vocational Education Commission / National Apprentice and Industrial Training Authority
records.title_verbatim: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY (NATIONAL DIPLOMA LEVEL 5)
records.entry_as_published: Relevant NVQ level 4 qualification in relevant field or pass in CGE A/L examination

modules.title_verbatim: Identify user requirements for software solution
modules.outcome_verbatim: This unit covers the competencies needed to carryout requirement identification process of a software development project by identifying process boundaries and key stakeholders then document the business requirements

modules.title_verbatim: Analyze requirements and design functionality of software solution
modules.outcome_verbatim: This unit covers the competencies required to check the system design specifications against outcomes and quality standards by analyzing therequirement and then design of software application followed by reviews
This unit covers the competencies required to design, implement and maintain the database
This unit covers the competencies needed to develop the designed application according to the standard of the selected programming language/s and carry out unit, integration, system tests.

This unit covers the competencies required to identify the print media & digital media concepts for the given project, create quotation for the project, design and develop required print media & digital media concept and store/transmit softcopy of the print media & digital media design adhering to environmental safety, health and legal requirement.

This unit covers the competencies required to identify the multimedia & digital media concepts for the given project, create quotation for the project, design and develop required multimedia & digital media concept and store/transmit softcopy of the multimedia & digital media design adhering to environmental safety, health and legal requirement.

modules.title_verbatim: Design, Develop and host web sites
modules.outcome_verbatim: This unit covers the competencies required to design, develop and host a website with frontend, backend validation and database operations

modules.title_verbatim: Manage computer networks with security measures and cloud environments
modules.outcome_verbatim: This unit covers the competencies required to prepare network layouts, setting up server environment, access cloud environment and manage the security feature
This unit covers the competencies required to design, develop, debug, test and deploy mobile App that fulfill the customer requirements.

This unit covers the competencies required to collect, organise and analyse information from a variety of sources, use organisational management information system for decision making and innovation, maintain a database for controlling progress of activities at the work place and maintain a standard documentation system.

This unit covers the competencies required to communicate with target group and stakeholders, present information in verbal, non-verbal and written forms, accompanied by visuals if required, and in structured form appropriate to the work force and the purpose

modules.title_verbatim: Plan Work to be Performed at the Workplace
modules.outcome_verbatim: This unit covers the competencies required in planning and scheduling work to be performed, assessing competencies / work capacities of individual workers / working teams predict problems / changes and take appropriate action to achieve business plans of the organisation

source.publication_or_revision: Second Revision 2025; NVQ Level 5 endorsed 08.07.2025, review 08.07.2028

verification.method: Unit titles and codes read from the rendered NVQ Level 5 schedule of units (PDF page 9); each unit descriptor from its unit page (PDF pages 18-60); facts from PDF pages 2, 7, 9 and 10; all matched against the pdf.js text layer.

notes: A national competency standard for the National Diploma in ICT, not evidence that a named provider delivers the programme. The document contains competency standards only; no curriculum modules or hours are published in it.
Stores the 12 NVQ Level 5 units (9 technical units and 3 employability units) with their descriptors; the three NVQ Level 6 packages are not stored.
Unit titles follow the Level 5 schedule; some unit pages capitalise them differently (e.g. 'Develop and test software', 'Plan Work to be Performed at Work place').
The NVQ Level 6 page states 'Date of Review: 08.07.2025', the same as its endorsement date; the Level 5 page states 08.07.2028.
Revision 2 is the latest on the NVQ portal; revision 1 there is the 2009 first publication (2026-10-18).
scope_verbatim: Level 5: Covers essential skills in software development, system analysis, digital electronics, web design, databases, networking, cybersecurity, and multimedia.
